title: Catawba Cruising

services.name: Choose a Cruise
services.desc: Cruising on Lake Erie is about having fun and enjoying the ride. That’s where Captain Tommy comes in. His experience and knowledge of the Great Lakes rivals any captain in the area, and his goal is to make sure your experience is unforgettable and unparalleled. Rates are based on six people, according to U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) charter boat regulations. Spend a full day exploring the U.S. Lake Erie islands. Enjoy swimming, water sports, bird-watching, and other local attractions. Includes up to $200 in fuel - any additional fuel needs will be passed along at cost.
